atoms.description: Submit an ACP integration manifest; get a deterministic INTEGRATION_SOUND / INTEGRATION_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE review across seven sections (disambiguation and scope, adapter architecture, protocol surface, lifecycle correctness, streaming discipline, security, honesty/tests/upgrade path), including a computed flavour-recognition check against the skill's ACP-client / ACP-comm vocabulary, with per-check evidence.

Submit a declared agent context-pack manifest; get a deterministic PACK_SOUND / PACK_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections (scope declaration, redaction, structure and manifest, reproducibility and signing, handoff dossier, freshness and privacy) with per-check evidence.

Submits an agent-evaluation evidence manifest and returns a deterministic TRUSTED / NOT_TRUSTED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE scorecard across eight sections (task suite, reproducible runs, judging, regression gates, beyond accuracy, incident replay, scorecard, benchmark hygiene), including a computed per-task acceptance check against declared cost/latency allowances, with per-check evidence.

Submit a declared agent-interoperability design manifest; get a deterministic DESIGN_SOUND / DESIGN_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight sections (protocol selection, bridge architecture, gateway and remote access, handoff contracts, identity and credentials, versioning and discovery, audit and provenance, handshake testing and red lines) with per-check evidence.

Submits an agent-safety evidence manifest and returns a deterministic GUARDED / NOT_GUARDED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight guardrail sections (injection defense, tool least privilege, approval gates, sandboxing, budgets and circuit breakers, output validation, secrets hygiene, red teaming) with per-check evidence.

Submit an agentic-coding practice manifest; get a deterministic RELIABLE_PRACTICE / NOT_RELIABLE_PRACTICE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six practice sections (spec and slicing, hooks and events, feedback loop, guardrails, context and tools, delegation and access) with per-check evidence.

Submit an algorithm design manifest (decomposition, complexity reasoning, data-structure and pattern declarations, correctness and edge-case record, verification and optimization record); get a deterministic DESIGN_SOUND / DESIGN_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed skill-mapping, pattern-toolbox and fatal-scale checks, with per-check evidence.
Submits a ledger-design evidence manifest and returns a deterministic SOUND / UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict on append-only ledger invariants and design posture with per-check evidence.

Submit a declared applied-ML validation manifest; get a deterministic VALIDATED / NOT_VALIDATED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections (framing and baseline, data audit and leakage, model ladder, evaluation and honesty, robustness and limits, deployment monitoring and card) with per-check evidence.

Submit an architecture-decision evidence manifest (NFRs, boundaries and versioned contracts, declared alternatives with trade-offs, ADR format, reversibility and security, dependency and supersession record); get a deterministic ADR_COMPLETE / ADR_NOT_COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed alternatives-count (stated 2-3 range) and one-page-max checks, with per-check evidence.

Submits an argument-analysis evidence manifest (argument anatomy, evidence quality, calibration, stress test, fallacy and bias screening, razors, countercase) and returns a deterministic ARGUMENT_ANALYSIS_COMPLETE / ARGUMENT_ANALYSIS_DEFICIENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed fallacy-screen and bias-screen set-inclusion checks against the skill's named fallacies and biases and a confidence-range check, with per-check evidence.

Submits a decision-process evidence manifest and returns a deterministic SOUND / UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections (framing, preset criteria, loss function, rigor sizing, data discipline, review) with per-check evidence.

Submits an audience-contract evidence manifest (user classes, single source of truth, progressive formality, failure behaviour, authority lattice, verification, identity) and returns a deterministic AUDIENCE_CONTRACT_COMPLETE / AUDIENCE_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including a computed classes-with-path count and authority-lattice checks gated on declared dangerous actions, with per-check evidence.

Submits an authentication and authorization design evidence manifest (human auth, sessions, OAuth, service tokens, authorization, lifecycle, anti-abuse, audit) and returns a deterministic AUTH_DESIGN_SOUND / AUTH_DESIGN_DEFICIENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including password checks gated on passwords being used and OAuth checks gated on OAuth being used, with per-check evidence.

Submits a backend-engineering evidence manifest (API contract, boundary validation, idempotency, error taxonomy, jobs and queues, data safety, observability) and returns a deterministic PRODUCTION_READY / NOT_PRODUCTION_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed error-taxonomy coverage against the skill's five named categories and checks gated on declared mutating operations, migrations and async jobs, with per-check evidence.

Submits a base-rate card manifest (claim and evidence, declared reference class with counts and stated rate, steelman, fallacy spot-check, calibration, second-order judgment) and returns a deterministic CARD_COMPLETE / CARD_NOT_COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including a computed base-rate consistency check (stated rate re-derived from successes over class size) and a fallacy-coverage check against the skill's named fallacies, with per-check evidence. Checks the card's internal consistency; it does not source reference-class data.

Submits a behavioural-finance bias-check manifest (decision context, bias playbook with considered biases, precommitment, cooling-off, decision journal, watch-and-challenge, temptation and red lines) and returns a deterministic BIAS_CHECK_CLEAR / BIAS_CHECK_FAILED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed cooling-off (48 hours for entry decisions) and position-size versus caller-declared cap checks, with per-check evidence.

Submits a behavioural-finance debiasing manifest (bias screening against the skill's catalogue, found bias patterns, prospect-theory reframing, precommitment with rebalancing band, journal and checklists, whole-portfolio view, guardrails) and returns a deterministic DEBIASED / NOT_DEBIASED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including a computed rebalancing-drift versus caller-declared band check and a report-only position-share figure, with per-check evidence.

Submits a quant study-pack manifest (preregistered hypothesis, data hygiene, distribution and stationarity evidence, multiple-testing discipline, cost coverage, reproducibility) and returns a deterministic STUDY_PACK_COMPLETE / STUDY_PACK_NOT_COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed cost-coverage, stability-across-periods and reported-vs-tested coherence checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared study pack; it does not run the study.

Submits a brand-mention monitoring manifest (inventory and coverage, triage rubric, response policy, alert hygiene, counts, digest reporting, conduct) and returns a deterministic TRIAGE_DIGEST_READY / TRIAGE_DIGEST_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed triage-dimension and triage-route coverage and evidence-for-every-action checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared design; it does not build the extension.

Submits a budget-design manifest (scope, lines with owners and drivers, totals, revenue link, contingency, approval baseline, monitoring, close) and returns a deterministic BUDGET_DESIGN_SOUND / BUDGET_DESIGN_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed line-amount, declared-total, balance-against-income and horizon checks, with per-check evidence. Submits a buyer-test / POC record manifest (hypothesis, criteria set upfront, timebox and scope, disposition and production boundary, evidence, decision and findings) and returns a deterministic CARD_COMPLETE / CARD_NOT_COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed timebox and decision/disposition vocabulary checks, with per-check evidence. Submits a claim-evaluation manifest (declared claim set, evidence-hierarchy and conflict record, base-rate and reference-class record, steelman and fallacy-screen record, calibration record, second-order and judgment record) and returns a deterministic CLAIM_EVALUATION_COMPLETE / CLAIM_EVALUATION_NOT_COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE review across six sections, including computed claim-entry completeness, fallacy-coverage and hit-rate re-derivation checks, with per-check evidence. One failure breaks the claim.

Submits a data-analysis deliverable record (question framing, data provenance, declared figures with re-derivation inputs, statistical care, insight and action, reporting and reproducibility) and returns a deterministic DELIVERABLE_COMPLETE / DELIVERABLE_NOT_COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed re-derivation of the stated total, mean and percent change from declared values, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it runs no analysis and certifies no conclusions.

Submits a licence-posture manifest (components, licences, distribution model) and returns a deterministic COMPLIANT / NON_COMPLIANT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE check with per-check evidence. A check over declared evidence, not legal advice.

Submits a link-integrity evidence manifest (scan posture, declared link rows with observed statuses, archive captures, canonicalization, notarization records, serving and repair records) and returns a deterministic LINK_INTEGRITY_SOUND / LINK_INTEGRITY_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed archived/notarized-citation and rotted-citation-repaired checks over the declared links, with per-check evidence. Audits declared scan evidence; it does not fetch URLs.
atoms.display_name: Link rot scan and notarized archive

atoms.description: Submits a network-exposure evidence manifest (inventory, declared public endpoints and sending domains, segmentation, TLS, DNS/email authentication, edge/access and egress posture) and returns a deterministic SOUND / UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed plaintext-endpoint, public-admin-endpoint and email-authentication checks that name offending endpoints, with per-check evidence.

Submits a portfolio manifest (returns series, optional benchmark, holdings, factors, stress scenarios, decision journal) and returns deterministic risk analytics — risk metrics, drawdown path, historical VaR/CVaR, Sharpe/Sortino, beta/correlation/tracking error/alpha, concentration, carry, factor decomposition, holding correlations, caller-submitted stress tests, decision-journal calibration — with status complete / partial / insufficient_evidence and every gap named. Numbers only: no recommendations, nothing labeled optimal; every computed float serialized at exactly 6 decimal places under a fixed rule shared by both cores.

Submits a prediction-model evidence manifest (target and decision, baseline and holdout, split/feature declarations with availability times, calibration observations, drift and deployment posture) and returns a deterministic PREDICTION_AUDIT_SOUND / PREDICTION_AUDIT_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed feature-availability leakage, temporal-split, holdout-beats-baseline and calibration-error checks, with per-check evidence.

Submits a predictive-maintenance evidence manifest (strategy fit, P–F window, condition monitoring, prediction discipline, reliability frame, data and integration) and returns a deterministic ASSESSMENT_SOUND / ASSESSMENT_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections with per-check evidence. Checks declared evidence only; runs no inference.

Submits a pump/conveyor drive manifest (declared duty and operating point, motor sizing, pump and conveyor records, baselines, interface and protection, declared drives with required duty vs motor ratings) and returns a deterministic SUITABLE / NOT_SUITABLE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed rated-vs-required power/torque, NPSH and starting-torque checks, with per-check evidence.

Submits a retrieval-system evidence manifest (corpus and chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking and filters, index hygiene, evaluation, serving and privacy) and returns a deterministic RAG_EVALUATION_SOUND / RAG_EVALUATION_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed recall@k, MRR and nDCG against per-query declared thresholds and scope-leakage checks, with per-check evidence.

Submits a portfolio performance manifest (beginning value, period-end values, external flows, optional benchmark, declared returns, holdings, transactions) and returns deterministic reconciled performance — time-weighted and money-weighted returns, a three-leg reconciliation against declared data, and benchmark comparison — with status complete / partial / insufficient_evidence and every gap named. Numbers only: no recommendations.
Submits a release-evidence manifest and returns a deterministic READY / NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five release bars with per-check evidence.

Submits a declared code graph (sources, sinks, sanitizers, transforms and directed data-flow edges) and returns a deterministic taint analysis — every source→sink pair classified tainted (shortest unsanitized path reported), sanitized, or unreachable, with a fixed severity table on sink kind — with verdict TAINTED / CLEAN / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Analyses the declared graph only; code is never parsed.

Submits a declared backtest-evidence manifest (harness standards, protocol and reporting, costs and frictions, overfit and fragility evidence, paper-trading gate, live monitoring and house gates) and returns a deterministic VALIDATED / NOT_VALIDATED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including a recomputed parameters-to-data ratio reported without an invented acceptance bar, with per-check evidence. Validates declared evidence; it does not run a backtest.

Submits a declared authorization policy pack manifest (decision model, policy code, declared policies and their tests, rollout, decision logs, governance and enforcement) and returns a deterministic READY / NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed default-deny and per-policy test-coverage checks that name untested policies, with per-check evidence. Checks declared evidence only; no policy is executed.

Submits a declared VFD application manifest (application profile, power quality, motor/cable/drive records, protection and control, commissioning, troubleshooting, records and red lines) and returns a deterministic SOUND / NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed declared-vs-declared harmonic-distortion, cable-length and derated-current checks, with per-check evidence. Declared values only; nothing is measured.

Submits a declared vulnerability register manifest (inventory and scanning, triage, patch SLAs, mitigation and exceptions, verified closure, disclosure and metrics, with declared findings and dates) and returns a deterministic CLOSURE_SOUND / CLOSURE_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed SLA-age checks against the manifest's declared as-of date that name offending findings, with per-check evidence. Checks declared evidence only; nothing is scanned.

Submits a declared zero-knowledge architecture claims manifest (claim basis, server access and storage, client-side encryption, key journey, trusted parties and recovery, plaintext and metadata scope, theater and threat model) and returns a deterministic CLAIMS_SOUND / CLAIMS_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, with per-check evidence. Audits declared claims only; no proof or system is verified.

Submits a declared zero-trust evaluation pack (the claim and its scope, the authentication and server-trust gauntlet, identity and authenticator strength, privilege segmentation and verification, trust inventory, honest limits) and returns a deterministic CLAIM_SUSTAINED / CLAIM_NOT_SUSTAINED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed Argon2id and minimum-secret-length checks against the skill's stated values, with per-check evidence. An evaluation over declared evidence; not a certification.

comment: Live-atom registry for the atoms gateway. An atom is live only when it appears here AND its handler is registered in src/atoms-registry.ts. Rates do NOT live here — tools/sync-rates.mjs reads them from each atom's contract.yaml (the source of truth) and generates src/generated.ts. Category: the register carries no per-atom category field, so it is recorded here at onboarding (taxonomy from the atoms-app design: finance, engineering, self-help, philosophy, ...).
